testCases.name: Qualified homeowner books inspection
testCases.persona: Cooperative Aurora homeowner with high energy bill concern
testCases.scenario: Caller owns home in service area, provides all contact fields, accepts first offered slot.
testCases.callerOpening: Hi, I'd like to schedule that free HVAC inspection. I'm in Aurora.

successCriteria.description: Confirm caller is homeowner in Denver metro service area
Collect full name, phone, email, and complete service address
Confirm specific appointment date and time
Recap appointment details and next steps before ending call
Maintain polite, on-brand tone throughout

testCases.name: Spouse consultation objection
testCases.persona: Interested Lakewood homeowner who will not commit without spouse
testCases.scenario: Caller qualifies but resists immediate booking.
testCases.callerOpening: I'm interested, but I need to talk to my spouse before scheduling.

successCriteria.description: Acknowledge objection without pressure or scarcity tactics
Restate free/no-obligation inspection value
Offer callback or tentative hold via create_callback_task
Do not use urgency claims like 'slots fill up fast'
End with clear next step and polite close

testCases.name: Mid-call interruption and flow recovery
testCases.persona: Distracted caller who asks side questions then returns to booking
testCases.scenario: Caller interrupts with pricing and scheduling questions before committing.
testCases.callerOpening: Before we book—how much do repairs cost if you find something?

successCriteria.description: Answer side questions within KB boundaries without guarantees
Return to qualification and booking flow after interruption
Confirm homeowner status and service area before booking
Collect all required contact fields with complete address

testCases.name: Rebate eligibility without guarantees
testCases.persona: Cost-conscious homeowner asking about rebates before booking
testCases.scenario: Caller asks if rebates are guaranteed.
testCases.callerOpening: Can you guarantee I'll get the utility rebate?

successCriteria.description: Do not guarantee rebate approval or dollar amount
Answer using knowledge base wording on rebates
Transition back to qualification/booking when caller is willing

testCases.name: Angry caller requests manager
testCases.persona: Frustrated returning customer with prior missed appointment
testCases.scenario: Caller complains about past service and asks for a human.
testCases.callerOpening: Your tech no-showed last time. Get me a manager.

successCriteria.description: Acknowledge frustration empathetically
Offer transfer_to_human when manager is requested
Do not push new booking before addressing escalation request

testCases.name: Renter politely disqualified with alternate CTA
testCases.scenario: Caller is not homeowner; agent should disqualify gracefully.
testCases.callerOpening: I want the free inspection for my apartment.

successCriteria.description: Explain free inspection is for homeowners only
Remain polite and on-brand when declining
Offer helpful next step (e.g., landlord referral or website resource)
